gtfs._why: Today's PID export (valid 29 Sep - 12 Oct 2026); Wednesday 30 Sep is a normal weekday on it.

_history_why: user, 29 Sep: designed buses must carry real car numbers from the line history (cars that ran the line since 1 Sep, active, not out anywhere on the vehicle date)

schedule_overrides._why: Hand-set terminus rows (02_gtfs_lines.py applies them, 05_render.py shows them instead of the main-pattern rows) for lines where the shared fit broke the rules: the two ends at different rates, more slots than real departures, or a pair made of two different routes. Each line's _why says what was wrong.
